summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for compute credits, manual/scheduled research, cron webhook, and UI budget/limits/report flows on preview. Added a reusable pytest suite for scheduler and credit guardrails; backend passed with one auth-coverage skip due no creator-owned token in provided mint set.

minor.issue: Creator-only 401/403 path could not be executed against provided mint list because none returned owner!=null in this environment (test skipped).

ui_bugs.issue: Frequency/model selector controls are not consistently addressable on mobile via stable testid selectors; id-based selector lookup was flaky in one mobile run.

action_items: Provide one known creator-owned token fixture/mint in preview so automated 401/403 creator authorization checks can run deterministically.
Add explicit data-testid attributes for estimator model/frequency dropdown triggers/options to improve mobile automation reliability.
Security hardening: rotate and remove committed secrets from backend/.env in source control; load only via environment injection.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_routes.view intentionally omits funded from public payload; ledger invariant validation required DB-backed verification in tests.
Cron endpoint contract is correct: auth required, malformed envelope returns 400, duplicate x-webhook-id accepted without duplicate dispatch.
Schedule authority mismatch correctly pauses schedule via dispatch path.
Critical security concern: backend/.env currently contains plaintext runtime secrets in repo (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (critical compute flows passed; one mobile selector testability gap)

seed_data_creation: No permanent auth accounts created. Test activity added internal test-credit topups and compute runs on FARTCOIN community-test account; schedules disabled at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile screenshots captured at required sizes (1920x800 and 390x844) under /app/test_reports/iteration7-*. Backend suite validates: topup validation/idempotency/cap, concurrent run guard, low-balance/day-cap/per-run/pause blocks, manual-completion schedule gate, cron auth+malformed+duplicate handling, due scheduled run completion, authority-mismatch pause, FARTCOIN known run id privacy + ledger invariant. Creator authz path remains unverified due environment token ownership availability.
rca of the issue: 1) Skipped creator auth test RCA: provided canonical tokens currently resolve as community-test (owner null), so creator-only 401/403 path has no deterministic target. Mitigation: seed/declare one creator-owned mint for CI. 2) Mobile selector RCA: estimator controls rely on id/combobox structure without dedicated data-testid hooks; on narrow layout this produced intermittent non-location. Mitigation: add stable testids on trigger and option nodes.
